title: Marryandbride announcement bar
description: A thin near-black bar across the top of the page (40px on phones, 30px from 1024px) with one short centred uppercase message at a time; every few seconds the message crossfades to the next. A small × at the right closes it.
notes: uses bg-foreground / text-background, so it is always the inverse of the page
static HTML shows the first message; the rotation and the close button need JavaScript
under reduced motion the messages still change, without the fade
